# pvecli backup

Backups: list, coverage, run, restore, prune, jobs.

| Command | What it does |
|:--|:--|
| [`list`](list.md) | Backups of every guest, on every backup storage (newest first). |
| [`status`](status.md) | Backup coverage of each guest: covering job, last backup, last run. |
| [`run`](run.md) | Back up guests now (one vzdump per node), then check each guest. |
| [`restore`](restore.md) | Restore a backup as a new guest, or over a stopped one with --force. |
| [`remove`](remove.md) | Delete backups. A protected backup is never deleted (unprotect it first). |
| [`protect`](protect.md) | Protect backups: neither pruning nor removal will delete them. |
| [`unprotect`](unprotect.md) | Remove the protection of backups. |
| [`notes`](notes.md) | Set the notes of a backup. |
| [`prune`](prune.md) | Prune backups by retention: preview from PVE first, then remove once confirmed. |
| [`files`](files.md) | Browse the files of a Proxmox Backup Server backup (read only). |
| [`jobs`](jobs.md) | Scheduled backup jobs: list, add, edit, remove, enable, disable, run. |
